articles.title: Bitmine's Ethereum bet nears $9 billion loss as ether falls below $1,800
articles.snippet: Shares of Tom Lee's Ethereum treasury firm hit their lowest level since the company's crypto pivot as ETH revisits the February lows.

articles.title: Hyperliquid bear turns bullish after losing over $46M shorting HYPE
articles.snippet: The whale is now backing Arthur Hayes’ favored HYPE, ZEC and NEAR plays, signaling a sharp pivot toward momentum-led crypto bets.

articles.title: Trezor says Safe 7 chip flaw found by Ledger does not put funds at risk
articles.snippet: Trezor and Tropic Square disclosed a TROPIC01 chip vulnerability found during a Ledger Donjon audit, saying the Safe 7 wallet and user funds remain secure.

articles.title: Russian ruble stablecoin A7A5 grows despite Western sanctions: CertiK
articles.snippet: Russian ruble-backed stablecoin A7A5 processed over $110 billion in transactions despite Western sanctions, according to CertiK.

articles.title: Cardano’s TapTools to wind down after 5 execs exit
articles.snippet: Despite the planned wind-down, TapTools says it is open to being acquired or taking on external resources to continue maintaining the platform.
